headline: Extends the federal Emergency Medical Services for Children program through fiscal year 2019.
what_it_does: This law amends the Public Health Service Act to keep the Emergency Medical Services for Children program running through fiscal year 2019. The program supports emergency medical care for children who are sick or hurt. The official summary does not describe any other changes, so this law mainly continues an existing program for a set period.

who_it_affects.how: The program that supports emergency care for sick or injured children continues to receive federal authorization through fiscal year 2019.

who_it_affects.group: Emergency medical services providers and hospitals that serve children
who_it_affects.how: They may continue to work with the federally supported program during the extension period.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed into law on September 26, 2014, and the program authorization runs through fiscal year 2019.
